title: Netflix’s Next Big Summer Anime Movie Shares New Look
content: In the anime streaming wars, Netflix reigns supreme. While outlets like Crunchyroll and HIDIVE focus entirely on the anime medium, Netflix’s staggering number of subscribers means that this streaming service is where anime is watched the most worldwide.
author: ComicBook

title: Netflix Is Quietly Losing the Most Diverse and Influential Shonen Anime This August
content: Netflix has become one of the best platforms, and arguably the second best, for streaming anime today. However, licensing issues occasionally force the platform to remove popular series, and this August, one of the greatest shonen anime of all time is set to leave Netflix.
author: ComicBook

title: Stupid Never Dies Action Game's Videos Reveals Theme Songs, October 21 Release
content: Osaka-based game development studio GPTrack50 revealed in a new video on Wednesday that its Stupid Never Dies action game will launch for PlayStation 5 and PC via Steam on October 21 (October 22 in some regions). Sega will distribute the game.
author: ANN

title: THE RIBBON HERO Reveals Final Trailer and More Cast Ahead of Next Week's Global Premiere
content: THE RIBBON HERO , the new film based on Osamu Tezuka’s Ribbon no Kishi ( Princess Knight ) has revealed its final trailer and more voice cast. This is the franchise’s first anime project in 27 years , and it will premiere globally exclusively on Netflix on August 8, 2026.
author: Anime Corner

title: BanG Dream! Ave Mujica Film's Trailer Reveals October 16 Opening
content: The official YouTube channel for the BanG Dream! franchise began streaming a new trailer for the BanG Dream! Ave Mujica prima aurora anime film project on Thursday, and it reveals that the film will open in Japan on October 16. The video also shows a new visual: The BanG Dream! It's MyGo!!!!!
author: ANN

title: A Shonen Jump Series is Coming to an End Right After Its Anime Debut
content: While Weekly Shonen Jump has created some of anime’s most legendary franchises, some of which are still releasing new chapters to this day, this fact doesn’t mean that every series will run in perpetuity.

title: Light Novel 'Tsuihou Sarete Shounin wa Kane no Chikara de Sekai wo Sukuu' Gets TV Anime
content: Publishing company Shufu to Seikatsusha announced a television anime adaptation of Daken's Tsuihou Sarete Shounin wa Kane no Chikara de Sekai wo Sukuu ( The Exiled Merchant Saves the World with the Power of Gold ) light novel on Friday.
